salon_loyalty_config_complete.name: salon_loyalty_config_complete
salon_loyalty_config_complete.value:
("salon"."loyalty_mode" = 'tiers' AND "salon"."tiers" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("salon"."loyalty_mode" = 'stamps' AND "salon"."stamp_target" IS NOT NULL)

session_exactly_one_principal.name: session_exactly_one_principal
session_exactly_one_principal.value:
("session"."principal_kind" = 'member' AND "session"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."staff_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("session"."principal_kind" = 'staff' AND "session"."staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."member_id" IS NULL)

session_revoked_has_reason.name: session_revoked_has_reason
session_revoked_has_reason.value: "session"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "session"."revoked_reason" IS NOT NULL

transaction_amount_sign_matches_kind.name: transaction_amount_sign_matches_kind
transaction_amount_sign_matches_kind.value:
("transaction"."kind" IN ('topup', 'deposit_return') AND "transaction"."amount_fils" > 0)
          OR ("transaction"."kind" IN ('charge', 'deposit_hold', 'shop') AND "transaction"."amount_fils" < 0)
          OR ("transaction"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "transaction"."amount_fils" <> 0)

loyalty_event_stamp_has_card.name: loyalty_event_stamp_has_card
loyalty_event_stamp_has_card.value:
"loyalty_event"."kind" <> 'stamp_reward_ready'
          OR ("loyalty_event"."stamps_after" IS NOT NULL AND "loyalty_event"."stamp_target" IS NOT NULL)

loyalty_event_kind_matches_fields.name: loyalty_event_kind_matches_fields
loyalty_event_kind_matches_fields.value:
("loyalty_event"."kind" = 'tier_climb' AND "loyalty_event"."stamps_after" IS NULL)
          OR ("loyalty_event"."kind" = 'stamp_reward_ready' AND "loyalty_event"."to_tier" IS NULL)

idempotency_key_completed_has_response.name: idempotency_key_completed_has_response
idempotency_key_completed_has_response.value:
"idempotency_key"."status" = 'in_progress'
          OR ("idempotency_key"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_key"."response_body" IS NOT NULL
              AND "idempotency_key"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

wallet_token_consumer_requires_consumpti.name: wallet_token_consumer_requires_consumption
wallet_token_consumer_requires_consumpti.value:
"wallet_token"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
          OR ("wallet_token"."consumed_by_staff_id" IS NULL AND "wallet_token"."consumed_by_transaction_id" IS NULL)

topup_intent_failure_reason_matches_stat.name: topup_intent_failure_reason_matches_status
topup_intent_failure_reason_matches_stat.value:
("topup_intent"."status" = 'failed' AND "topup_intent"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("topup_intent"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "topup_intent"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("topup_intent"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled') AND "topup_intent"."failure_reason" IS NULL)
